description: This Java source file defines a class `EcuDefinitionHandler` that extends the SAX `DefaultHandler` for parsing XML files related to ECU (Engine Control Unit) definitions. It extracts ECU metadata from XML elements and attributes, stores them in a map, and provides detailed logging and detail string methods.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionHandler
classes.description: A SAX XML parser handler that processes ECU definition XML files to extract ECU data into a map for further use.

methods.name: startDocument
methods.description: Initializes the ECU definition map at the start of XML parsing.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, resets relevant fields if a 'romid' element begins, and processes 'rom' element inherit attribute.

methods.name: characters
methods.description: Accumulates character data within an XML element into a StringBuilder.

methods.name: endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of XML elements, constructs ECU definitions from accumulated data, and populates the map.

methods.name: getEcuDefinitionMap
methods.description: Returns the map of ECU definitions parsed from the XML.

methods.name: romDetail
methods.description: Generates a detailed string description of the current ECU's data for logging.
